subject: project:gdl
value: On functions larger than roughly 4000 instructions, arbitrate every ambiguous matching probe with the objdiff fuzzy_match_percent from build/GUNE5D/report.json, never with fndiff real-line counts. Register-color and label cascades move the real count by hundreds of lines in either direction while fuzzy moves the opposite way; multiple PlayerMotion gains (86.19% to 97.13% cumulative) were built on probes whose real count went up. Probe signs are also alignment-sensitive: a parked probe measured fuzzy-negative can turn positive after surrounding regions improve, so re-A/B parked probes after nearby fixes.

attributes.examples: 0x904 two-phase store-reload split: fuzzy-negative at 92%, fuzzy-positive at 94.8% with identical code
